name: run
signature: run(alg: str, parameters: dict, context: QgProcessingContext = None, feedback: QgProcessingFeedback = None) -> dict
description: Runs a processing algorithm by ID with the given parameters. Returns a dictionary of output values.

name: runAndLoadResults
signature: runAndLoadResults(alg: str, parameters: dict, context: QgProcessingContext = None, feedback: QgProcessingFeedback = None) -> dict
description: Runs an algorithm and automatically adds output layers to the current project.

name: createFeatureSink
signature: createFeatureSink(output: str, definition: QgProcessingParameterDefinition, fields: QgFields, geometryType: QgWkbTypes.GeometryType, crs: QgCoordinateReferenceSystem) -> tuple[str, QgFeatureSink]
description: Creates a new output vector layer (sink) for algorithm results. Returns (sink_id, sink).

name: parameterAsSource
signature: parameterAsSource(parameters: dict, name: str, context: QgProcessingContext) -> QgProcessingFeatureSource
description: Extracts an input layer parameter as a feature source for iteration.

name: parameterAsLayer
signature: parameterAsLayer(parameters: dict, name: str, context: QgProcessingContext) -> QgMapLayer
description: Extracts an input layer parameter as a QgMapLayer object.

name: parameterAsOutputLayer
signature: parameterAsOutputLayer(parameters: dict, name: str, context: QgProcessingContext) -> str
description: Extracts an output layer parameter as a file path string.

name: parameterAsExtent
signature: parameterAsExtent(parameters: dict, name: str, context: QgProcessingContext) -> QgRectangle
description: Extracts an extent/bounding box parameter as a QgRectangle object.

name: parameterAsCrs
signature: parameterAsCrs(parameters: dict, name: str, context: QgProcessingContext) -> QgCoordinateReferenceSystem
description: Extracts a CRS parameter as a QgCoordinateReferenceSystem object.

name: parameterAsEnums
signature: parameterAsEnums(parameters: dict, name: str, context: QgProcessingContext) -> list[int]
description: Extracts an enumeration (multiple choice) parameter as a list of integer values.

name: parameterAsString
signature: parameterAsString(parameters: dict, name: str, context: QgProcessingContext) -> str

name: parameterAsDouble
signature: parameterAsDouble(parameters: dict, name: str, context: QgProcessingContext) -> float

name: parameterAsInt
signature: parameterAsInt(parameters: dict, name: str, context: QgProcessingContext) -> int

name: parameterAsBool
signature: parameterAsBool(parameters: dict, name: str, context: QgProcessingContext) -> bool

name: QgProcessingFeedback
description: Base class for processing algorithm feedback. Use setProgress() to report progress, pushInfo() for messages.

name: QgProcessingContext
description: Execution context for processing algorithms. Holds temporary layers, project reference, and execution flags.

name: QgProcessingUtils.generateTempFilename
description: Generates a unique temporary file path with the given basename.
